title: Swagger Petstore - OpenAPI 3.0
notes: Vendored 2026-06-12, 19 operations, 6 schemas (no trimming needed). Assigned hard: it is the largest vendored spec and includes multipart/form-data and form-encoded request bodies, schemaless responses, and OAuth2 + apiKey security.

title: Swagger Petstore (expanded)
notes: Vendored 2026-06-12 (the original OAI/OpenAPI-Specification URL now 404s; the examples moved to the learn.openapis.org repo). 4 operations, 3 schemas, allOf composition, one 204.

title: USPTO Data Set API
notes: Vendored 2026-06-12 (the original OAI/OpenAPI-Specification URL now 404s; the examples moved to the learn.openapis.org repo). 3 operations, 1 schema; server URL variables, form-encoded request body, response without a JSON schema.

title: TaskHub
notes: Feature-stress: plain CRUD (7 operations, 9 schemas), apiKey header auth (X-Api-Key), string enums, date-time formats, integer path param, one 204 response.

title: Ledgerly
notes: Feature-stress: bookkeeping API (12 operations, 13 schemas), bearer auth, cursor pagination (cursor/limit query params), arrays of objects, integer minimum constraints, array-valued query params, 404 + default Error responses.

title: Polyform Content Store
notes: Feature-stress: content store (14 operations, 16 schemas), oneOf + discriminator (Block = TextBlock | ImageBlock | EmbedBlock), allOf composition over BlockBase, nullable fields, uuid/date/date-time/email formats, mixed apiKey + bearer auth varying per operation (including one AND requirement and one public op), deeply nested DocumentMetadata.
